biotools.summary: TA2Viewer is a web-based browser for Terminologia Anatomica (TA2) providing interactive exploration of anatomical terms and associated medical information. It links to various online resources, including Google searches, PubMed, and Wikipedia, fostering access to anatomical knowledge and terminology.
